articles.title: Ukraine launches more than 500 drones at Russia, killing 3: Moscow
articles.summary: Ukraine executed an unprecedented overnight drone attack, deploying over 500 drones against Russia. Russian authorities confirmed three fatalities in the Moscow region, stating air defences intercepted 556 drones across numerous regions. This massive assault marks a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict, showcasing Ukraine's evolving long-range strike capabilities and the widespread nature of drone warfare.

articles.title: IAF begins process to replace VIP transport fleet, issues RFI for new long-range business jets
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force (IAF) has formally begun the process to replace its ageing VIP transport fleet. An RFI (Request for Information) has been issued for the procurement of four to six Long Range Business Jets. This initiative aims to modernize the fleet, ensuring secure and efficient transportation for VVIPs, reflecting the IAF's commitment to continuous operational upgrades and maintaining high standards for critical national duties.

articles.title: Four killed in Ukrainian drone attack on Russia
articles.summary: Almost 600 Ukrainian drones launched a massive overnight attack on Russia, targeting Moscow and Belgorod regions. Authorities reported four fatalities – three in Moscow and one in Belgorod. Russian air defences successfully intercepted 556 drones, highlighting the intensity of ongoing cross-border drone warfare. This significant assault underscores the persistent escalation in the Ukraine-Russia conflict, critical for understanding current global security dynamics.

articles.title: US Aims to Double Nuclear Submarine Production - Document
articles.summary: The article snippet highlights a significant US initiative to double its nuclear submarine production. This move signals a substantial expansion of American naval power and strategic deterrence capabilities. For SSB aspirants, this development is crucial for understanding evolving global defence landscapes, great power competition, and the strategic importance of underwater assets in modern warfare scenarios.

articles.title: [New] Task Manager closes immediately (Win10)
articles.summary: A recurring technical issue affects Windows 10 users, causing Task Manager to crash instantly when accessing the Performance tab. This software malfunction, previously discussed in support forums, impedes users' ability to effectively monitor system resources. Such operational glitches highlight common operating system challenges and the ongoing need for robust troubleshooting and potential software updates for stability.

articles.title: segnomms added to PyPI
articles.summary: This notice announces SegnoMMS software is in beta, meaning core functionality is stable and tested. However, APIs may change in minor versions, so users are advised to pin to specific versions for consistency. This development phase ensures thorough testing and refinement before a full public launch, signifying a robust product still undergoing minor technical adjustments.

articles.title: Ringo Starr Launches 2026 All Starr Band Tour May 28 in Temecula with Star Lineup
articles.summary: Legendary Beatles drummer Ringo Starr has announced his 2026 All Starr Band tour, marking his return to the road. The tour is scheduled to commence on May 28, 2026, at the Pechanga Resort Casino in Temecula, California. This announcement provides fans with details of the initial leg of his upcoming concert series.

articles.title: Conformalized TabPFN: Prediction Intervals for a Pretrained Transformer for Tabular Data in Python and R
articles.summary: Conformal prediction is a crucial technique in data science, addressing the need to understand model prediction confidence. It provides statistically valid prediction intervals, which quantify the reliability of a model's forecast. This method offers guaranteed coverage, ensuring that predictions come with a defined level of certainty. It's vital for informed decision-making where understanding prediction accuracy and confidence is paramount.
